chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad Ja'far al-Hamdani (mercy of Allah be upon him) said: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from his father, from Abd al-Salam ibn Salih al-Hirawi, from al-Rida (peace be upon him)

He (AS) said: I asked him, 'For what reason did Allah, the Mighty and High, drown the whole of the earth in the time of Nuh (peace be upon him), while there were children among them who were free of sin?' He replied: 'There were no children among them, because Allah, the Mighty and High, made the male reproductive systems of the people of Nuh and the wombs of their women barren for forty years, so their lineage was cut off; thus they drowned and there was no child among them. And Allah, the Mighty and High, would not destroy with His punishment anyone who is without sin. As for the rest of the people of Nuh (peace be upon him), they were drowned for denying the Prophet of Allah, Nuh (peace be upon him). And the rest of them were drowned by their agreement with the deniers. And whoever is absent from a matter and agrees to it is like one who witnessed it and committed it.'

key_terms.أَعْقَمَ أَصْلَابَ: made the male reproductive systems infertile/barren
key_terms.وَمَنْ غَابَ عَنْ أَمْرٍ: and whoever is absent from a matter

ai.seo_question: Why were there no children in the flood of Nuh according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) resolves the theological query regarding the flood of Nuh by clarifying that the 'children' perished were not offspring of the main population but rather a distinct generation born from the barrenness of the primary lineage, ensuring no innocent children were punished. He further elucidates the principle of collective responsibility, noting that those who acquiesced to the deniers' rejection were considered equal to those who actively denied, thereby justifying their inclusion in the divine punishment.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 2. Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja`far al-Hamdani (RA) said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim said, on the authority of his father, on the authority of `Abd Al-Salam ibn Salih al-Hirawi that Al-Rida (AS) said:

I asked him, “For what reason did Allah, the Mighty and High, drown the whole of the earth in the time of Nuh (AS), while there were children among them who were free of sin?” So he (AS) replied, There were no children among them, because Allah, the Mighty and High, made the male reproductive system infertile and the female wombs barren for forty years. Thus, their lineage was cut. So He drowned them while there were no children among them. Allah, the Mighty and High, does not destroy with His Punishment anyone who is without sin. As for the rest of Nuh’s (AS) people then they were drowned for belying Nuh, the Prophet of Allah, (AS). They were all drowned for agreeing with the belying ones. Whoever is absent from a matter, and agrees to it, is like one that witnesses it and commits it.
